Driver stays seated facing the road, lips closed, hands steady on the same steering wheel. @Video1 is PRECEDING footage, only continuity context for this truck, robe, lighting and motion; continue AFTER its ending, do not replay its opening. @Image1 supplies only the existing driver's face and hair, not clothes or pose.
